population.span: Patients were considered eligible if they had a recent MI ( < 30 days).

endpoint.span: The primary efficacy endpoint was a composite of CV death, resuscitated cardiac arrest, MI, stroke, or urgent hospitalization for angina requiring coronary revascularization.

estimate.span: The primary end point occurred in 5.5% of the patients in the colchicine group, as compared with 7.1% of those in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.77; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.61 to 0.96; P = 0.02).

ci.span: The primary end point occurred in 5.5% of the patients in the colchicine group, as compared with 7.1% of those in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.77; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.61 to 0.96; P = 0.02).

treatment_strategy.span: COLCOT was an international multicentre, randomized, double-blinded trial that randomly assigned patients to receive either low-dose colchicine (0.5 mg once daily) or placebo.

follow_up.span: Patients were followed for a median of 22.6 months.

absent_reason.analysis_set: No held source explicitly identifies the analysis set for the overall HR of 0.77. The full-text safety-population statement applies to the separate time-to-treatment analysis, not this estimate; randomized totals alone do not establish ITT.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Entry criteria require adults with acute myocardial infarction within the last 30 days, within the question population.
entry_population_matches_question.span: Inclusion Criteria: * Males and females of at least 18 years of age capable and willing to provide informed consent * Patient must have suffered a documented acute myocardial infarction within the last 30 days

notes: The served HR and CI match the main-trial abstract. The held full text is a COLCOT time-to-treatment secondary analysis (PMID 32860034); its original-trial design and endpoint descriptions are usable, but its subgroup estimates and safety analysis set do not bind the overall HR. The served ITT label remains unverified. Registry evidence is used to confirm adult entry eligibility.
